title: Podcast: Qualifications of a Specialized Carrier

body_markdown: Carriers who haul over-dimensional freight such as machinery, wind turbines and data storage centers have a unique skillset. Landstar’s Vice President and Chief Safety & Operations Officer Joe Beacom explains the qualifications a shipper should look for when choosing a heavy/specialized carrier in this podcast from *[Inbound Logistics](http://www.inboundlogistics.com/cms/podcast/)* .
